name: obsidian-skills
description: Agent skills for working in an Obsidian vault

interface.shortDescription: Read, write, and run tasks in an Obsidian vault
interface.longDescription: Search, read, and edit an Obsidian vault through the obsidian CLI - notes, daily notes, frontmatter properties, tags, backlinks, and templates - and run a note-per-task system where each task is its own note, adding tasks, completing them, rolling recurring chores forward, and periodically reviewing the base for work that has gone unscheduled or stale.
